title: Right unit for relative tensor products of mixed bimodules
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category with coequalizers, such that $Z\otimes-$ and $-\otimes Z$ preserve colimits for every $Z$. Let $S,R$ be monoid objects [sk-def-sfb-ring-object]. An $S$-$R$-bimodule $P$ is an object with a unital associative left $S$-action $\gamma_P$ and a unital associative right $R$-action $\rho_P$, commuting with each other; module objects and their morphisms are as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Bimodule morphisms commute with both actions. Let $R$ also denote its regular $R$-$R$-bimodule, with both actions its multiplication. Write $\alpha$ for the ambient associator and $\rho^{\mathcal C}$ for its right unitor.

The relative tensor product $P\otimes_R R$ is the coequalizer of
$$
(P\otimes R)\otimes R\mathrel{\substack{\xrightarrow{\rho_P\otimes R}\\[-2pt]\xrightarrow{(P\otimes\mu_R)\circ\alpha_{P,R,R}}}}P\otimes R,
$$
with left action through $P$ and right action through the last $R$; denote the coequalizer map by $q$. There is an isomorphism of $S$-$R$-bimodules
$$e_P:P\otimes_R R\xrightarrow{\sim}P,\qquad e_P\circ q=\rho_P.$$
Its inverse is $q\circ(P\otimes\eta_R)\circ(\rho^{\mathcal C}_P)^{-1}$, where $\eta_R:\mathbf1\to R$ is the unit. No equality of $S$ and $R$ is assumed.
